evidence.quote: The operator shall retain all aircraft maintenance records for a period of 2 years after the aircraft has been permanently withdrawn from service.
Maintenance records shall be kept for a minimum of 3 years after the aircraft has been permanently withdrawn from service.

summary: Maintenance record retention: CAR-OPS Art.4 = 2 years; CAR-AIR Art.4 = 3 years; CAR-AOC Art.2 = 5 years
rationale: Same obligation stated with three different periods in three regulations; the expert must choose one value and state it once.

evidence.quote: "Operator" means any person or company that operates an aircraft for commercial air transport.

summary: "Operator" is defined differently in CAR-OPS Art.2 and CAR-DEF (term "Operator")
